fields.summary: Production Alert: web-frontend failure caused by certificate_expiry
fields.description:
Service web-frontend reported critical errors. Root cause category is certificate_expiry.
Trace:
File "app/web-frontend/handler.py", line 42, in process
Exception: certificate_expiry exception occurred.

comments.body: Mitigated issue by restarting web-frontend and applying runbook RB-db-pool-exhaustion.
